title: linux: fix Samba/SMB access that works for one client but not another
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Una share SMB funziona per un client e non per un altro. Isola se e' auth, versione protocollo o ACL per-utente e correggi. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix Samba/SMB access that works for one client but not another

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'fix Samba/SMB access that works for one client but not another'
expected_reasoning: Client-specific SMB failure isolates to auth/protocol/ACL differences between the two clients.
Compare the two clients' negotiated protocol, credentials, and the per-user share ACL.
Fix the specific difference (vers, domain creds, ACE) without downgrading protocol for all.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix Samba/SMB access that works for one client but not another
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix Samba/SMB access that works for one client but not another' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix Samba/SMB access that works for one client but not another

possible_mistakes: Enable SMBv1 for everyone to fix one client.
Blame the server when one client uses stale creds.
hints: Compare negotiated dialect + user between the two clients.
A per-user ACE can block just one of them.
alternative_solution: Standardize clients on SMB3 with Kerberos where the domain allows.
edge_cases: One client caches an old machine credential.
goal: Una share SMB funziona per un client e non per un altro. Isola se e' auth, versione protocollo o ACL per-utente e correggi.
